choice.basis: The chart's vertical axis is labeled 'Count' with tick marks 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, 1000, 1200, and 1400 arranged from top to bottom, indicating that higher values are positioned lower on the page. The blue data series starts near the 0 tick on the left (Jan 27, 2020) and moves continuously downward to near the 1400 tick on the right (Mar 22, 2020). This geometric progression, read against the printed axis labels, represents a sharp increase in the number of reported cases over the reporting period. This rising trajectory corresponds to the 'rising-case escalation follow-up' option.
choice.option_label: Route the surveillance record to rising-case escalation follow-up
